maria: Heads-up — customer @BetaInc reports charts in mobile compact view are losing one series and tooltips show values for a different series after the analytics deploy (~11:05 PDT). BetaInc-prod. Screenshot: https://s3.redwood.example/betainc/err_20260316.png
ops-bot: deploy-bot: rollouts/analytics v3.14 deployed to prod at 2026-03-16T18:05:12Z
kevin: thanks, tagging @lee. Maria can you paste repro steps & browser/device?
maria: Repro steps:
1) Login to BetaInc-prod
2) Open Dashboard "Billing Overview" on iPhone (Safari, compact width)
3) Observe the 'billing' series missing from chart legend and tooltip shows 'usage' value when tapping points
Network/request: GET /api/metrics?org=betainc&range=1h&series=billing,usage -> 200 OK but payload contains 'usage' only
Console (customer): no obvious errors, attaching HAR
```json
{"url":"/api/metrics?org=betainc...","series":["usage"]}
```
lee: I can repro on iPhone 14 / Safari 17 in staging. Looks like the legend layout calc runs before series are fully mounted in compact reflow. Tooltip mapping likely uses index that shifts when an item is hidden. Suspect race in measureLegend() -> setState ordering.
sam: Also seeing this in desktop narrow viewport in Chrome: Uncaught (in promise) TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading '0') at legend.js:45
kevin: I'll try a guard around the index mapping and re-run unit for legend measurement. Pushing a quick patch to PR: https://github.com/redwood/console/pull/4823
ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary rollout for console v3.14.1 started (2% nodes) at 2026-03-16T20:10:03Z
maria: BetaInc marked this P1 for them (billing totals incorrect in mobile), they need ETA to decide whether to rollback.
kevin: if canary is clean ETA about 2h to promote. If we see errors will rollback. Adding feature-flag 'legend-measure-fix' so we can toggle quickly.
maria: thanks — I'll inform customer and collect device HARs and console logs. Please ping when canary is green.
kevin: will update in-channel once canary checks finish. :thumbsup:
